text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with our field sales team for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

1. Time came back. Reps cut post-call admin from 25 minutes to under 10. That meant more selling, not more typing.

2. CRM data got better. Next steps and decision-makers were logged consistently for the first time.

3. Trust took work. Some customers hesitated until reps explained the tool upfront. Asking consent early became part of the opening.

4. Summaries weren't strategy. The AI captured what was said, but reps still had to read between the lines.

5. Coaching improved. Managers used call snippets instead of recollections.

The takeaway: AI note-takers free up attention. What reps do with it is the real test.
